verdict.rationale: Docs show a Dashboard where each session's status, risk factors, and check results can be viewed, and reviewers can manually override a failed verification via an 'Override Result' button, implying a review workflow feeding back into the record (plaid-idv-docs-7, plaid-idv-docs-19, plaid-idv-docs-20, plaid-idv-docs-11). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'manual review queue' for borderline cases, no mention of viewing raw document images/extracted fields inline for reviewers, and no described mechanism for how a reviewer's decision structurally updates the verification record beyond a binary override. Missing for 10: explicit review-queue UI for borderline sessions, display of document images/extracted fields to reviewers, and documented reviewer-decision audit trail feeding back into the record.
